text: We tested repeated self-distillation of the student's own labels, run for 2 distill_rounds, with gpt2-medium as the weak supervisor and qwen2.5-7b as the strong student, across 4 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.53 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling was 0.92, while the self-distilled student reached a transfer accuracy of 0.56 (SE 0.05). The resulting performance gap recovered was 0.08 with a standard error of 0.14, compared with a baseline PGR of 0.09. The PGR does not exceed the baseline, and the standard error on PGR is large relative to both values, so these data do not support a claim that self-distillation improves weak-to-strong generalization here; nor do they rule out a modest effect in either direction. With only 4 seeds, the estimates are imprecise and should be treated as preliminary. Further seeds, and possibly more distillation rounds, would be needed to resolve the direction of any effect.
